Name: Dust Spirit Floors
Author: 1A2B3C4DABCD
Description:
I made this mod out of sheer frustration because I desperately needed to farm coal, but Dust Sprites barely spawned.
You can customize the settings via the Generic Mod Config Menu or by editing the `config.json` file in the `DustSpiritFloors` folder.
[list]
[*][b]Enable force spawn[/b]: When on, monsters on the configured floors can be forced to Dust Spirites.[/*]
[*][b]Min floor[/b]: Inclusive minimum mine floor.[/*]
[*][b]Max floor[/b]:  Inclusive maximum mine floor.[/*]
[*][b]Force spawn chance[/b]: Chance a monster roll becomes a Dust Spirit(1 = always, All monsters changed to Dust Sprites ).[/*]
[*][b]Spawn chance multiplier[/b]: Multiplies how often monsters appear on those floors(1 : vanilla).[/*]
[*][b]Allow elevator floor spawns[/b]: If on, floors like 40/50 cqan spawn monsters(vanilla: none).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the file and put the [b]DustSpiritFloors[/b] folder inside the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI 4.0+ [/color]
